question: Can unknown positive word kernels be constructed, exactly completed and distinguished without supplying a target Hamiltonian or state?
scope: Executable unknown noncommutative moment search; exact finite CAR/transfer realizations under declared search premises. No physical source-selection proof.
summary_de: Positive Wortkerne werden automatisch gesucht und exakt als vollständige endliche Kerne realisiert. Zwei Fünf-Moden-Kerne stimmen in allen 2245 Momenten bis Grad 4 überein; eine automatisch gefundene Zweifeld-Transferprobe unterscheidet sie ab Grad 5. Modellannahmen und ursprüngliche Naht bleiben getrennt.
summary_en: Unknown positive word kernels are searched and exactly realized as complete finite kernels. Two five-mode completions agree on all 2245 moments through degree 4; an automatically found two-field transfer probe distinguishes them at degree 5. Model premises remain separate from the original seam.

Internal quarter rotation, not yet physical chiral quarter holonomy
Search objectives and optional positive transfer floor are choices, not physical source laws
Five-mode completion uses an explicitly additional minimal irreducible Fock representation; pure occupations are inferred from found moments
positive_results: Unknown moments are generated without a supplied Hamiltonian, density matrix or target kernel
